scope: Preview newsletter return first-paint and focus fix. Uses the same ten-minute public note context, now consumed from session storage immediately after display and held only in memory until note restoration. No email, new provider, backend or analytics conversion added.

checks.disclosures: Read existing newsletter and browser storage disclosures in privacy.html and terms.html. No new collection, retention or disclosure. Storage marker lifetime reduced; UI confirmation remains separate from webhook conversion.
checks.security: Same-origin callback/connected-frame restrictions preserved. Invalid timestamps and unsupported placements stay inert. Confirmation can close before feed readiness without replay or focus theft.

openItems: Fresh hosted provider submission and physical iPhone Gmail Open/Cancel are not retested in this patch.
Production promotion still needs its own readiness check and distinct Beehiiv form/redirect verification.
